My entryway is proof that you do not need designer prices to create a space that feels polished, warm and expensive. I’m always looking for pieces that give me that elevated modern organic / quiet luxury look without blowing the budget, and this little entry is one of my favorite examples.

The faux travertine entry table is under $200, but it gives the look of a much more expensive stone console. I layered it with a large arched entryway mirror to bounce light around and make this smaller space feel taller and more open, then added battery-operated wall sconces so I could get that custom designer lighting look without hiring an electrician.

They’re affordable, tuck perfectly underneath the console table and add just enough softness and shape to balance all the clean lines.

Small spaces don’t need a ton of decor either — a few larger-scale pieces, warm textures and good lighting can make such a difference.
